title: Clean the CVT on a Yamaha 155 scooter
summary: Open the CVT on an NMAX, Aerox or LEXi, blow out belt dust and check the belt, rollers and sliders.
tools: Variator holder and clutch holder, or an impact wrench
parts: Roller weights and sliders, if flat-spotted or cracked

steps.text: Park on the center stand with the engine cold. Remove the CVT air intake duct and filter housing to free the cover.
Loosen the CVT cover bolts in a crisscross pattern and lift the cover off. Note where the longer bolts go.
Hold the variator with the holder and remove the front pulley nut, washer and outer pulley face. Slip the belt off.
Hold the clutch housing and remove the clutch nut, then pull the clutch and rear pulley out as a set.
Remove the variator and take out the roller weights and sliders.
Blow the belt dust out of the case and wipe every pulley face with brake cleaner on a rag.
steps.caution: Wear a mask; belt dust is fine and irritating. Keep cleaner and grease off the belt and the pulley faces.

steps.text: Measure the belt width and compare it to the service limit in your service manual. Replace a belt that is narrow, cracked or glazed.
Replace rollers with flat spots and sliders that are cracked or worn thin.
Reassemble in reverse order. Push the belt down into the rear pulley before tightening the front pulley so it isn't pinched between the faces.
Tighten the clutch and pulley nuts to the torque in your service manual, refit the cover and duct, and test-ride at low speed.
steps.caution: A loose pulley nut can let the variator come off at speed. If you don't have the torque values and holders, have a shop do this step.
